check_settings.smoke_split: train on the coverage pool (1,000 episodes, 100,000 transitions); validate on the 50 smoke episodes (5,000 transitions)

chosen_values.history_padding: copies of s_0 with a zero action, plus a mask input (1 real, 0 padding); all models
chosen_values.dtheta_from_prediction: atan2 of the predicted (cos, sin) = current + predicted change, minus the current angle, wrapped to (-pi, pi]

alignment.padding: copies of s_0 with a zero action, mask 0
alignment.pass_condition: every example pairs s_t, the history up to t-1, a_t and s_{t+1}; nothing after t

target.pass_condition: dtheta wraps across +-pi on a hand-built episode; the box target from the states matches the stored one (from qpos) to 1e-9

scaling.pass_condition: the scaler is fitted on the training split only; changing validation data leaves it unchanged

splits.pass_condition: no episode seed or transition hash appears in two splits; Phase 0 uses smoke seeds only

2_wiring.unit: shared training loss on 5,000 training examples (std-MSE in the real training split's state-change scaler; 0.5 box + 0.5 pusher), of the one-step prediction; mlp-ms is trained on rollouts over made-up episodes (zero_rollout, action_rollout)
2_wiring.pass_condition: made-up training loss below 0.01; blind is expected not to fit the action target

overfit_64.pass_condition: training loss on the 64 examples below 0.01

losses_fall.pass_condition: L_obs(100) < L_obs(0) and best L_obs < L_obs(100), every architecture and width

beats_baselines.pass_condition: best and last L_obs below copy and constvel, every architecture and width

matching.pass_condition: matched checkpoints and exclusions equal a brute-force recomputation of DESIGN.md's rule; every architecture has a run reaching V*

budget.pass_condition: full number of updates, constant learning rate, checkpoints every 10 updates to 1,000, every 100 to 2,000, then every 1,000; plateau criterion and whether the run continues past its best checkpoint are reported

reproducibility.pass_condition: a rerun with the same seed gives the same L_obs and training-loss curve, bit for bit (CPU)

5_compute.design_estimate: minutes per run for mlp and mlp-ms, tens of minutes for gru and contact_wm on one CPU core; 80 + 60 runs in three to five days of CPU
5_compute.note: one thread per run; 8 runs in parallel on the machine below, so times include some contention. Train time excludes evaluation at checkpoints (eval_seconds). The real budget is set by the pilot.

solo.note: one thread, one run at a time; includes L_obs at every checkpoint of the schedule
